record.paper_title: Syzygies of projective varieties of large degree: recent progress and open problems.
record.original_question: Let X be a smooth projective variety of dimension n, fix a weight q with 1 <= q <= n, and let L_d be a sufficiently positive line bundle as in the paper. Do there exist normalizing functions F_q(d), depending on X and the geometric data, such that the Betti numbers k_{p_d,q}(X;L_d) become asymptotically Gaussian after normalization, namely F_q(d) · k_{p_d,q}(X;L_d) -> e^(-a^2/2) whenever p_d approaches r_d/2 + a·sqrt(r_d)/2 as d -> infinity? The source also asks for the analogous behavior for the twisted groups k_{p,q}(X,B;L_d).

evidence.quote: We conjectue that the same pattern holds universally:

Conjecture 3.2. Returning to a smooth projective variety X of dimension n, ﬁx q ∈ [1,n ]. Then there is a normalizing function Fq(d) (depending on X and geometric data) such that Fq(d) ·kpd,q(X;Ld) − →e−a2/2 as d → ∞ and pd → rd / 2 + a · √rd / 2 .
One expects slightly more generally that the analogous statement is true for the dimensions kp,q(X,B ;Ld) with B a ﬁxed twisting line bundle.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a smooth complex projective variety of dimension $n$, and let $B$ be a fixed line bundle on $X$ (the "twisting" bundle; one may take $B = \mathcal{O}_X$ as a basic case). Let $\{L_d\}_{d \gg 0}$ be a family of sufficiently positive line bundles on $X$ — concretely, take $L_d = dA + P$ where $A$ is an ample divisor and $P$ is an arbitrary fixed divisor, with $d \to \infty$. For each $d$, embed $X$ by the complete linear series $|L_d|$ and consider the graded Betti numbers
$$k_{p,q}(X, B; L_d) \;=\; \dim_{\mathbb{C}} \operatorname{Tor}^{S_d}_p\!\big(R(X,B;L_d),\,\mathbb{C}\big)_{p+q},$$
where $S_d = \operatorname{Sym}^\bullet H^0(X, L_d)$ and $R(X,B;L_d) = \bigoplus_{m \ge 0} H^0(X, B + mL_d)$. Write $k_{p,q}(X;L_d) := k_{p,q}(X,\mathcal{O}_X;L_d)$.

Set $r_d = h^0(X, L_d) - 1$, so that $X \subset \mathbb{P}^{r_d}$ via $|L_d|$. Fix an integer $q$ with $1 \le q \le n$.

Question. Does there exist a normalizing function $F_q(d)$ (depending on $X$ and the geometric data, in particular on $A$, $P$, $B$, $q$) such that, for every fixed real number $a \in \mathbb{R}$ and every sequence of integers $p_d$ with
$$p_d \;=\; \frac{r_d}{2} \;+\; \frac{a\sqrt{r_d}}{2} \;+\; o(\sqrt{r_d}) \qquad (d \to \infty),$$
one has
$$F_q(d)\cdot k_{p_d,q}(X;L_d) \;\longrightarrow\; e^{-a^2/2} \qquad\text{as } d \to \infty,$$
and the analogous Gaussian normalization
$$F_q(d)\cdot k_{p_d,q}(X,B;L_d) \;\longrightarrow\; e^{-a^2/2}$$
holds for every fixed twisting line bundle $B$?
artifact.status_search_result: The Gaussian-asymptotics conjecture for the Betti numbers $k_{p,q}(X;L_d)$ is widely cited as an open conjecture of Ein–Erman–Lazarsfeld. Partial evidence has been accumulated: a heuristic via random flag complexes (Ein–Erman–Lazarsfeld, 2018), explicit data and verification in special cases such as Veronese embeddings and $\mathbb{P}^1\times\mathbb{P}^1$, results in the semi-ample growth setting (Yang, 2019), and asymptotic syzygy results for products of projective spaces (2024). No source found establishes the full Gaussian-normalization conjecture for general smooth projective $X$ and arbitrary twist $B$.

status_evidence.title: Random flag complexes and asymptotic syzygies (Ein–Erman–Lazarsfeld)
status_evidence.snippet: Stanley–Reisner ideals of random flag complexes are used as evidence for the conjecture that asymptotic Betti numbers should be approximately normally distributed.
status_evidence.claim: Provides probabilistic evidence but not a proof of the Gaussian asymptotics conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Asymptotic Syzygies in the Setting of Semi-Ample Growth (arXiv:1904.04944)
status_evidence.snippet: Extends asymptotic-syzygy results to semi-ample line bundle sequences, including non-vanishing statements.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress on asymptotic behavior, not a full proof of Gaussian normalization.

status_evidence.title: Syzygies of P^1 x P^1: data and conjectures (arXiv:2104.14598)
status_evidence.snippet: Computational data on Betti tables consistent with the conjectured Gaussian profile in a specific surface case.
status_evidence.claim: Empirical support, conjecture treated as still open.

status_evidence.title: Asymptotic syzygies for products of projective spaces (2024)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies asymptotic Betti numbers for products of projective spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Special-case progress, full conjecture not resolved.
